name: Header Sentinel
description: Audits HTTP security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and friends) on one URL or a list, and prints a scored report.

name: FavBuster
description: Extracts and fingerprints favicons from a target list — useful for tracking phishing kits that reuse the same asset hash.

name: LazyDNS
description: Passive DNS record dumper for a domain: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT and CNAME with batch output for IOC enrichment.

name: Cookie Secure Auditor
description: Checks session cookie flags (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, expiry) across authenticated and unauthenticated responses.

name: ADS Tracer
description: Enumerates alternate data streams on a directory tree and flags unexpected streams on executables — a classic NTFS hiding spot.

name: Event Log Snapshot
description: One-shot collector that exports Security, PowerShell and Sysmon logs plus a running process list into a triage folder.

name: Service Shadow
description: Dumps every Windows service with its binary path, account and start type, highlighting paths in user-writable folders.

name: Signin Anomaly Pack
description: Ten ready-to-paste KQL queries for impossible travel, legacy auth, risky device and unfamiliar-location reviews.
usage:
// paste into Microsoft Sentinel / Log Analytics
SigninLogs | where ResultType != 0 | summarize count() by UserPrincipalName

name: Entra Lockout Analyzer
description: Correlates 4740 lockouts with the source workstation and preceding 4625 failures to find the spraying host.

name: Sentinel Fusion Starter
description: Starter fusion rules chaining suspicious sign-in + mail forwarding + inbox rule creation into a single incident.
usage: // requires Analytics rules 1, 4 and 7 enabled as fusion sources

name: WhatThePhish
description: Full phishing triage pipeline: header parse, link defang, redirect chain walk and lookalike-domain scoring.

name: Header Forensics
description: Parses Received, Authentication-Results and ARC headers to reconstruct the true origin of a spoofed message.

name: Defang / Refang Toolkit
description: One-click defanger for indicators in reports: converts hxxp, [.] and (.) forms back and forth safely for chat and tickets.

name: Attachment Triage
description: Safely unpacks password-protected archives from mail, computes hashes and extracts embedded URLs without executing anything.

name: PE Entropy Scanner
description: Walks a folder of binaries, plots section entropy and flags packers or overlay blobs typical of loaders.

name: String Seeder
description: Extracts printable strings with IOC-shaped hits (IPv4, domains, URLs, hashes) highlighted and deduplicated.

name: Import Table Viewer
description: Dumps PE import tables and flags unusual API combinations (keylogging, injection, anti-analysis) as a first-pass read.

name: File Hasher
description: Batch-computes MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 for files or directories with CSV export for IOC ingestion.

name: IOC Extractor
description: Pulls IPv4 addresses, domains, URLs and hashes out of any text — reports, chat logs, sandbox output — with defanged output.

name: Hash Strength Checker
description: Educational estimator: shows collision resistance, truncation risk and why MD5/SHA-1 must never be used for integrity.
